description: Agent cursor visibility rules (plans/cmux-next/agent-cursor.md section 3; decisions CURSOR-HIDDEN, CURSOR-SHOW, CURSOR-SCREENS, 2026-10-04). Rects are points in one window's content view, flipped (origin top-left, y down); the resolver is pure and works in any such space. The sidebar row is at its true position (left of the panes), never moved onto the layout's edge. anchor is tabChip | tabStrip | columnEdge.<leading|trailing|top|bottom> | workspaceRow | windowEdge. Replayed by Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Tests/CmuxNextAgentCursorVisibilityTests.

cases.name: selected_tab_visible
cases.rule: CURSOR-SHOW: the selected tab of a visible pane draws the cursor in its page viewport

cases.name: background_tab_points_at_its_chip
cases.rule: CURSOR-HIDDEN: a background tab in its pane pulses at its tab chip

cases.name: background_tab_without_chip_points_at_strip
cases.rule: CURSOR-HIDDEN: a tab hidden in a collapsed tab group falls back to the strip

cases.name: selected_page_not_laid_out_points_at_chip
cases.rule: a selected tab whose page is not laid out yet pulses at its chip

cases.name: other_workspace_same_window_points_at_sidebar_row
cases.rule: CURSOR-HIDDEN: another workspace of the same window pulses at its sidebar row; never switches workspace

cases.name: tab_in_parked_workspace_points_at_sidebar_row
cases.rule: CURSOR-HIDDEN: a parked (mounted, not shown) workspace is another workspace: sidebar row (here its collapsed group row)

cases.name: sidebar_hidden_falls_back_to_window_edge
cases.rule: CURSOR-HIDDEN: with the sidebar hidden the indicator sits on the leading window edge

cases.name: workspace_without_sidebar_row_falls_back_to_window_edge
cases.rule: a listed workspace with no sidebar row (another profile) uses the window edge

cases.name: column_scrolled_out_left
cases.rule: CURSOR-HIDDEN: a niri column scrolled out to the left pulses at the leading strip edge; never auto-scrolls

cases.name: column_scrolled_out_right
cases.rule: CURSOR-HIDDEN: a column scrolled out to the right pulses at the trailing strip edge

cases.name: column_partially_visible_draws_with_clip
cases.rule: a partially visible column is visible: the viewport keeps its origin, the clip is the shown part

cases.name: column_under_docked_column_points_at_edge
cases.rule: a strip column wholly under a docked column is not visible: the edge of the uncovered strip

cases.name: row_scrolled_out_top
cases.rule: a pane scrolled out above (row scroll inside a column) pulses at the top edge

cases.name: background_tab_in_partial_column_chip_is_clipped
cases.rule: a background tab's chip in a partially visible column is cut to the shown part

cases.name: docked_devtools_uses_page_viewport
cases.rule: docked DevTools share the page area: the viewport is the page's part only

cases.name: page_zoom_is_reported
cases.rule: page zoom travels with the visible placement

cases.name: window_on_other_display_draws
cases.rule: CURSOR-SCREENS: a window on another display draws in that window

cases.name: window_on_other_space_draws_nothing
cases.rule: CURSOR-SCREENS: a window on another Space draws nothing

cases.name: minimized_window_draws_nothing
cases.rule: CURSOR-SCREENS: a minimized window draws nothing

cases.name: tab_closed
cases.rule: a closed tab draws nothing

cases.name: workspace_in_no_window
cases.rule: a workspace no window lists draws nothing

cases.name: window_showing_beats_window_listing
cases.rule: the window that shows the workspace wins over a front window that only lists it

cases.name: pane_not_on_active_screen_points_at_window_edge
cases.rule: a pane on another screen (screen bar) of the shown workspace uses the window edge

cases.name: target_pane_missing_points_at_window_edge
cases.rule: a pane the layout has not measured uses the window edge

cases.name: sidebar_row_at_true_position_in_window_space
cases.rule: CURSOR-HIDDEN: in window content-view space the workspace row anchor is the row itself, left of the layout (sidebar 240 pt wide), not moved onto the layout's edge

cases.name: sidebar_hidden_in_window_space_uses_window_edge
cases.rule: CURSOR-HIDDEN: with the sidebar hidden the layout fills the window; a stale row is ignored and the indicator sits on the leading window edge
